exception.justification: Justified: Startup acquisition precedes observation and all descriptor-opening bootstrap; its public inputs and outcome are recorded by the executable after the private handles are settled.

review.item_premise: Source review covers opaque role capabilities with fixed Debug, constant refusal classes and public accepted-byte counts. Acquisition contains no secret and runs before observation; the executable records its public convention and outcome. The two deliveries borrow only their own protected regions into the two labelled kernel-pipe exits, whose buffers are receiver custody. Formatting sees no descriptor, private byte or dependency text. Protection establishes the fixed two-page budget before observation workers. This recording confirmation neither establishes installed wiring nor substitutes for the conditional primitive-residue admission.
